screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.werewo: Dropped by feral werewolves and tribe members. It can also be exchanged with werewolf merchants and village leaders.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.silver: Combine one pelt, one Silver Ingot and one Wolfsbane to make two pieces of Silver-Tanned Hide.

ability.howlingwerewolf.pounce.desc: Press Z to aim at the ground, then attack to leap to the marker. Landing triggers the current form’s effect and grants Speed I for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
death.attack.howlingwerewolf:pounce.play: %1$s was struck by a pounce while fighting %2$s
item.howlingwerewolf.silverhide.set_bonu: Each piece grants +0.0125 movement speed and 12.5% protection from freezing and werewolf damage. Full set: 10% additional natural damage reduction.
item.howlingwerewolf.wolfsbane_potion.de: Cures werewolves; humans are poisoned for 60 seconds
Brewed from awkward potion and wolfsbane flower
item.howlingwerewolf.central_ritual_alta: The moon-oath heart of the Alpha Trial
One central altar; ordinary altars exactly 3 blocks east, south, west, and north at the same height
Offer an Alpha Badge at the center and one Moonbane Pearl outside at each point; use the center empty-handed

screen.howlingwerewolf.not_werewolf: You are not yet a werewolf.
screen.howlingwerewolf.not_werewolf.bite: A bite from a wild wolf or a werewolf may carry the curse into your blood. Live through it, and on the next night you will hear yourself howl.
screen.howlingwerewolf.not_werewolf.infe: The bite still burns; the curse is already in your blood. When night falls, you will hear yourself howl.
screen.howlingwerewolf.not_werewolf.poti: Rather not wait? Drink a Werewolf Potion and join the pack tonight. Welcome, my werewolf brother.
skill.howlingwerewolf.damage.desc: Each rank increases claw damage by 30%.
skill.howlingwerewolf.defense.desc: Each rank grants 8% natural damage reduction.
skill.howlingwerewolf.speed.desc: Adds 0.02 movement speed per rank while transformed.
skill.howlingwerewolf.resistance.desc: Ranks 1–3 remove Weakness, Poison, and Slowness; rank 4 adds Mining Fatigue and Blindness; rank 5 adds Wither and Darkness.
skill.howlingwerewolf.regeneration.desc: Heals 0.5 health per rank every 2.5 seconds while transformed.
message.howlingwerewolf.infected: A fever pulses outward from the fresh bite...
message.howlingwerewolf.awakened: Night settles over the world. The wolf buried beneath the wound opens its eyes, and strength surges through your limbs.
message.howlingwerewolf.full_moon: The full moon hangs high. An ancient covenant drags you into wolf form, and feral strength awakens with it.
message.howlingwerewolf.moon_sets: Dawn severs the moon's reins. You reclaim your human shape, but the beast's aftershock leaves your limbs heavy.
message.howlingwerewolf.moon_forced: The full moon holds absolute domain over your blood; tonight, there is no road back to human form.
message.howlingwerewolf.werewolf_on: Bones crack and reshape beneath a low snarl; dormant claws break through flesh as wild strength surges through your limbs.
message.howlingwerewolf.human_on: Claws recede beneath your skin as fury fades; the exhaustion of the beast leaves limbs heavy and hands unsteady.
message.howlingwerewolf.cured: The wolfsbane scours the lycanthropy from your blood.
message.howlingwerewolf.potion_awakened: The draught burns through your veins, waking the wolf within your bones with a surge of newborn strength.
message.howlingwerewolf.reset_unavailabl: Progression reset requires werewolf level 6 or higher.
message.howlingwerewolf.reset_success: Progression reset complete. Level %s; skill points %s; skill-tree points %s.
item.howlingwerewolf.alpha_werewolf_badg: Active while carried anywhere in the hotbar
Werewolf blood: grants 10 base werewolf XP per minute
Werewolf form: prevents one fatal hit; configuration can preserve the badge
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.full_moon: Full moons force transformation. Shifting into wolf form grants temporary Strength; reverting to human inflicts Weakness, Slowness, and Mining Fatigue.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.armor: Armored Instinct lets bipedal werewolves wear armor and elytra. Each piece with armor value reduces werewolf natural damage reduction by 25% and werewolf speed and jump bonuses by 17.5%. Zero-armor items such as elytra are exempt. Quadruped and Beast forms cannot wear equipment.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.fire: While transformed, you take 50% more fire damage.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.night_vision: Once you learn the Night Vision skill, transforming grants Night Vision.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.diet: While transformed, only meat is edible unless Hard Life is unlocked.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.silver: Werewolves take 50% extra damage from Silver Sword attacks and receive Weakness II.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.progression: Gain experience by killing creatures to advance the skill tree and learn abilities.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.level_scalin: Each level increases base damage and damage reduction.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.quadruped: Quadruped Wolf: unlock it by learning Wildstride Form; gain higher speed and jumping at the cost of slightly lower attack damage.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.beast: Alpha Beast Form: greatly increases attack damage and improves speed, jumping, and damage reduction, but drains hunger faster.
screen.howlingwerewolf.info.beast_warnin: This form may affect gameplay balance.
screen.howlingwerewolf.reset.title: Reset Werewolf Progression?
screen.howlingwerewolf.reset.warning: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
screen.howlingwerewolf.reset.clears: All skill-tree ranks and unlocked skills will be cleared.
screen.howlingwerewolf.reset.experience: Current level XP and bonus/admin points will also be cleared.
screen.howlingwerewolf.reset.points: After reset: %s skill points / %s skill-tree points
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.title: Trial of the Alpha's Moon-Crown
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.locked: Beast Form: the Moon-Crown is not yet yours
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.intro: Construct the five altars as illustrated below to initiate the rite, defeating the Silver-Oath Watchers followed by the Moon-Crowned Alpha. First victory unlocks Beast Form (press H). Repeat victories: Easy/Normal always returns 1 Moonbane Pearl; Hard awards 1 Skill Point, 1 Skill-tree Point, and 2 pearls (the primary method to gain additional points at max level).
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.layout: Layout: Altar 1 is central; 2–5 are outer altars placed 3 blocks away from the center (gray squares indicate the two intervening spaces). All five altars must share the exact same Y level.
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.items: Offerings: Place 1 Alpha Werewolf Badge on the central altar and 1 Moonbane Pearl on each of the 4 outer altars. All 4 pearls are consumed upon starting; victory consumes the badge, while defeat drops it beside the central altar.
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.requirement: Requirements: Must be started at night in the Overworld by a player at werewolf level 10+ in standard standing wolf form. No other players may be within the 18-block arena ward.
screen.howlingwerewolf.trial.warning: Warning: Dying, disconnecting, exiting the arena, breaking an altar block, or switching to Peaceful mode immediately fails the trial and dispels the ward. The ward barrier violently repels anything at its edge.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.awakening.i: There are two paths to lycanthropy: contracting an infection from a bite, or drinking a Werewolf Potion.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.awakening.b: Wild wolf attacks have a 10% infection chance, while Feral Werewolves have a 20% chance (configurable). Once infected, the condition incubates until you awaken on a later night.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.awakening.p: To skip the incubation period, brew and drink a Werewolf Potion to awaken your werewolf abilities immediately.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.awakening.f: Feral Werewolves only spawn in Overworld forests during full moons under sufficiently dark conditions.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.awakening.c: To cure your lycanthropy and restore your human form, drink a Wolfsbane Potion.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.transform.i: Once awakened, press J to shift between human and bipedal werewolf form.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.transform.k: Controls: K opens abilities, Z pounces forward, V toggles auto Night Vision, N summons Wolf Spirits, B uses Bloody Bite, R unleashes Moonblood Surge, and C opens Companions. All keys can be rebound in Controls.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.traits.intr: Lycanthropy provides immense physical advantages alongside distinct combat vulnerabilities.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.traits.hunt: Hunters leave humans alone and attack transformed players and tribe werewolves. Village patrols have 4–6 Hunters. Hunters cannot spawn within 48 blocks of tribe buildings.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.growth.poin: Each level brings Skill-tree Points and Skill Points: raise your attributes on the Skill Tree page and learn skills on the Skills page.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.growth.badg: With an Alpha Werewolf Badge in your hotbar and werewolf blood in your veins, you gain 10 base werewolf XP per minute, and the bonus applies in human form too.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.quadruped.k: Once learned, press G while transformed to switch between werewolf and quadruped form. The quadruped cannot wear equipment and carries its main-hand item in its mouth.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.beast.title: Beast Form
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.beast.key: Unlocked by your first Alpha Trial victory. Press H while transformed to switch between werewolf and Beast form; the Beast cannot wear equipment.
Offer a Moonbane Pearl and Wolfsbane at the five Moon-Oath Altars to call a werewolf brother who comes to trade.

Place a Moonbane Pearl on the center altar and a Wolfsbane on each of the four outer altars. Use the central altar empty-handed. The four flowers are spent, and the pearl stays in place for reuse or retrieval.
Right-click to trade. With Pack Oath unlocked, right-click the merchant with an Alpha Werewolf Badge and confirm to recruit him as a permanent companion.
Press C to open the companion menu. Order your companion to follow, guard, rest, sort containers, or hunt. The same menu supports recall, upgrades, revival, renaming, and coat changes.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.items.title: Items & Crafting
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.items.intro: Pick an item to see what it does, where it comes from and how it is made.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.wolfsb: Grows in taigas, and more rarely in forests, birch forests and dark forests. Every Hunter drops at least one, which makes Hunters the steadiest source. Brewed into Wolfsbane Potions, crafted into Moonbane Pearls, Moon-Oath Altars and Alpha Werewolf Badges, and used to summon a werewolf brother.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.silver: Found underground across the Overworld, in a deepslate variant too. Smelt it in a furnace or blast furnace for Silver Ingots.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.deepsl: The deeper variant of silver ore. Both a furnace and a blast furnace can turn it into silver ingots.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.silver: Smelted from Silver Ore; Hunters sometimes drop one. Used for Silver Swords and Alpha Werewolf Badges.
The werewolf's bane: its hits on a werewolf deal 50% more damage and inflict Weakness II. It is the blade Hunters carry.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.wolfsb: Brewed by adding Wolfsbane to an Awkward Potion. Restores a werewolf to human form; non-werewolves drinking it suffer Poison II for 60 seconds.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.werewo: Brewed by adding a Fermented Spider Eye to a Wolfsbane Potion. Drinking it instantly transforms a human into a werewolf and grants brief Strength.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.moonba: Crafted from an Ender Pearl and four Wolfsbane. Opens the Alpha Trial, calls a werewolf brother, goes into the Alpha Werewolf Badge and raises a companion's tier.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.alpha_: A Moonbane Pearl in the centre, four Silver Ingots and four Wolfsbane around it in any order. In your hotbar it grants 10 base werewolf XP per minute and, while you are transformed, stops one fatal blow. It also opens the Alpha Trial and recruits and revives companions.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.ritual: Eight Stone Bricks around one Wolfsbane. The Alpha Trial and the call of a werewolf brother both need four, set three blocks north, south, east and west of the central altar.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.centra: Crafted from a Moon-Oath Altar, four Gold Blocks and four Diamonds. It stands at the centre of the five altars; once the offerings are in place, right-click it with an empty hand to begin.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.damage.desc: Each rank increases claw damage by 30%.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.moon_rend.des: Each rank makes claw attacks deal additional damage equal to 0.6% of the target's maximum health.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.defense.desc: Each rank grants 8% natural damage reduction.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.speed.desc: Adds 0.02 movement speed per rank while transformed.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.resistance.de: Ranks 1–3 remove Weakness, Poison, and Slowness; rank 4 also removes Mining Fatigue and Blindness; rank 5 also removes Wither and Darkness.
Heals 0.5 health per rank every 2.5 seconds while transformed.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.jump.desc: Each rank adds 1.2 blocks of jump height.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.knockback_res: Each rank grants 50% knockback resistance; maximum rank fully prevents knockback.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.fall_resistan: The first rank reduces fall damage by 50%; the next ignores the entire fall-damage process.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.lifesteal.des: Heals 10%/15%/20% of final melee damage without exceeding maximum health.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.satiety.desc: Reduces transformed hunger use from 1.5x to 1.33x, 1.16x, then 1.0x.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.claw_efficien: Each rank increases empty-claw reach and adds one level of Looting to claw kills.
tree_skill.howlingwerewolf.hunting_maste: Kill XP becomes 60%, then 75%, of the victim's maximum health.
ability.howlingwerewolf.summon_wolf_spir: Press N to summon five spirits that follow and assist you for four minutes, with a 60-second cooldown.
ability.howlingwerewolf.quadruped_form.d: Press G to switch between normal werewolf and quadruped wolf form. Speed and jumping increase greatly, attack damage decreases slightly, and the quadruped cannot wear equipment.
Press R while transformed for powerful recovery, absorption, decaying Resistance, and combat buffs. Your recruited companions in the same dimension and within 16 blocks when you cast share the effects and the crash. Recalling them keeps the remaining time. Cooldown: 4 minutes. The Resistance skill can clear the penalties.
ability.howlingwerewolf.armored_instinct: Allows armor or elytra only in normal werewolf form. Each armor-bearing piece suppresses natural reduction by 25% and werewolf movement/jump bonuses by 17.5%; zero-armor equipment does not.
ability.howlingwerewolf.beast_mode.desc: Permanently unlocked after the first Alpha victory; press H to toggle it. Beast Form cannot wear equipment.
ability.howlingwerewolf.beast_mode.warni: Only one who tears the Moon-Crown from its bearer may wake the beast buried deepest in the blood.
ability.howlingwerewolf.hard_life.desc: Overcomes strict carnivory, allowing werewolves to consume bread, fruits, and other non-meat food while transformed.
Keeps one hotbar slot empty; items move only into the main inventory or other hotbar slots, and cannot be picked up when those are full.
ability.howlingwerewolf.long_claws.desc: Empty-hand attacks deal half damage to nearby enemies.
ability.howlingwerewolf.tool_claws.desc: Empty-handed harvesting while transformed treats claws as an iron pickaxe, axe, and shovel, matching iron tool harvest levels and speeds.
ability.howlingwerewolf.fire_claws.desc: Empty-hand attacks while transformed apply the equivalent of Fire Aspect II.
ability.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite.desc: Press B while transformed and empty-handed to bite the aimed target for 1.8x current claw damage and inflict Weakness II, Slowness III, Hunger, and Poison for 15 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.meat_only: A true beast rejects bland vegetarian fare.
message.howlingwerewolf.beast_on: The last chain of reason snaps. An ancient beast tears its way through flesh and bone.
message.howlingwerewolf.beast_off: The primeval fury ebbs; dreadful fangs withdraw as the colossal frame settles back into wolf form.
message.howlingwerewolf.beast_locked: The beast at the bottom of your blood still sleeps. Take the Moon-Crown in the Alpha Trial first.
message.howlingwerewolf.quadruped_on: Your spine lowers to the soil; four paws strike an ancient cadence as the open wild becomes your hunting ground.
message.howlingwerewolf.quadruped_off: Forepaws lift from the dust as you rise upright upon two legs; the breath of the chase still echoes in your chest.
message.howlingwerewolf.moonblood_on: Moonblood boils within your heart. Wounds close, and a silver tide floods every bone with strength.
message.howlingwerewolf.full_moon_no_sle: The full moon burns in your blood. You cannot sleep tonight.
message.howlingwerewolf.moonblood_cooldo: The fury in your veins has yet to settle; the moonblood tide will answer again in %s seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.moonblood_crash: The borrowed tide of moonfire dies away; cold exhaustion and crushing weight drag down your limbs.
message.howlingwerewolf.spirit_cooldown: Wolf spirits can be summoned again in %s seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite_cool: Bloody Bite will be ready in %s seconds.
message.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite_no_t: Aim at a living enemy within claw reach to use Bloody Bite.
message.howlingwerewolf.bloody_bite_requ: Bloody Bite requires an empty main hand.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.overworld_: No alien sky will witness this oath. The Alpha Trial belongs to the Overworld alone.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.night_only: Daylight still covers the land. The trial may only begin once night falls beneath the watching moon.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.already_ac: The trial ward upon this altar is still active; another hunt cannot be awakened simultaneously.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.level_requ: Your blood has not yet fully matured to bear the weight of the Moon-Crown. Return once you reach werewolf level 10.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.form_requi: The trial answers only a challenger standing in standard bipedal werewolf form. Put aside human guise, Wildstride, and Beast Form.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.single_pla: The moon-oath acknowledges only a single challenger. Ensure no other players stand within the 18-block ward.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.structure_: The altar structure or offerings are incomplete; the pearls on the outer altars cannot resonate with the central badge.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.begin: The badge lifts from the stone as four Moonbane Pearls rise along silver arcs—the arena seals, and the trial begins!
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.hunters_ar: A pale pillar of light pierces the sky! Seven Silver-Oath Watchers enter the ward with drawn steel—prepare for battle!
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.alpha_arri: The last watcher falls as a thunderous howl shatters the night—the Moon-Crowned Alpha descends! The final duel begins!
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.alpha_says: %s: “Beneath the pale moon, there is nowhere to hide!”
%s: “Pack, to me! By the authority of the Moon-Crown—tear this usurper limb from limb!”
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.alpha_revi: %s: “The Moon-Crown yields to no one!” A defiant roar shakes the ward as moonbane fire rekindles the Alpha's broken frame!
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.failed: The trial ends in defeat. The silver arcs dim and the ward shatters; the four Moonbane Pearls burn away into ash, while the Alpha Badge falls beside the central altar, awaiting another challenger.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.victory_fi: The Moon-Crowned Alpha crashes to the earth! The ancient beast stirs in the deepest reaches of your blood—the Moon-Crown is yours! Rewarded with 1 Werewolf Potion, 1 Moonbane Pearl, and 1 Alpha Werewolf Badge.
message.howlingwerewolf.trial.victory_re: The old Alpha falls once more. The rite concludes, returning 1 Moonbane Pearl to your hand.
The apex challenger is vanquished! Ruthless combat memory forges into your instinct: +1 Skill Point, +1 Skill-tree Point, and 2 Moonbane Pearls.

Recruit at tier 0; upgrades cost 2/4/8 Moonbane Pearls. Respeccing preserves companions and their belongings.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.empty: Learn Pack Oath, summon a merchant at the altar, then use a Werewolf Badge on him to recruit your first companion.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.owner_h: My Alpha, your orders? Only Guard retaliates for you. Right-click me to open my inventory.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.suspend: Skill or capacity reduced: resting. Recall and belongings remain available.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.cost_hi: Revive: 1 Badge · Upgrade: Pearls · 9 inventory slots
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.recruit: Consume one Werewolf Badge to recruit %s? He will stop trading and serve you as a tier 0 companion. Requires Pack Oath and an available slot.

screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.name_hi: Up to 32 characters. Save it empty to use the coat's name.

message.howlingwerewolf.companion.unavai: That command is unavailable in the current state. A hunting companion can only be recalled.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.no_spa: No safe space nearby. Move to clear ground and try again; your companion and items are preserved.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.dead: This companion has fallen. Revive him with a Werewolf Badge.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.upgrad: Your companion has reached the tier allowed by Pack Oath, or cannot upgrade in this state.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.invent: Recall the companion nearby before opening his inventory.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.died: %s has fallen. His nine-slot inventory is preserved; revive him in Companions.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.hunt_r: %s hunted for %s minutes and received %s loot rolls. Overflow was dropped nearby.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.ritual: This altar is already performing a ritual.
Place one Wolfsbane flower on each of the four outer altars and one Moonbane Pearl in the center.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.invali: Names may have up to 32 characters, without control or formatting codes.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.greet: Well met beneath the moon, brother. What errand moves you to summon me?
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.trade: A fair bargain, fairly struck. Good hunting to you, brother.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.recru: By the moon I swear it, %s: I am yours to follow, even unto death.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.hunti: By your will, %s. I shall hunt the sun and the moon for you; this road shall not be walked in vain.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.recal: I am returned to your side, %s.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.retur: The hunt is done, %s, and I return laden with its spoils.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.reviv: You have given me life anew, %s. It is yours, as it ever was.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.dismi: Here our oath is fulfilled, %s. Fare well on your moonlit road, until we meet again.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.disabl: Companions are disabled by this server.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.hunt_c: This companion must rest before hunting again: about %s game minutes remain.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.follo: Go before me, %s. I shall follow in your steps.
Lead on, %s. Where you tread, I shall tread.
By the moon, %s, this road we walk together.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.guard: My claws are whetted, %s. None shall come at your side.
While breath remains in me, %s, you shall not stand alone.
As you command, %s. I shall keep quiet vigil here until you call.
Go safely, %s. I shall await your summons beneath this moon.
I shall hold this ground, %s. One word, and I come.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.inven: All that I carry is yours to command, %s.
The spoils of our hunts are gathered here, %s. Take whatever you require.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.upgra: The moon has whetted my claws anew, %s. My oath holds as ever.
The pearl's strength runs in my veins, %s. I shall not fail your trust.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.renam: The name you bestow I shall bear with honour, %s.
A worthy name, %s. By it shall I walk beneath the moon.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.reski: A changed coat, %s, yet the same oath.
How say you, %s? Does this coat please you?
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.comba: Stand behind me, %s! This foe is mine.
You shall not face this foe alone, %s.
Let them come, %s! My claws shall tear through their ranks!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.wound: My wounds run deep, %s, yet my oath stands unbroken.
Grant me but a moment's breath, %s. I can fight yet.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.victo: The way lies clear, %s. Let us press on.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.farew: Long is the moonlit road, brother. Here I take my leave.
Our business is concluded, brother. Call upon me when next you have need.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.falle: %s... may the moon light your road home.
Forgive me, %s... my oath outlives this flesh.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.idle_: Long is the road, %s, and I shall walk it to its end beside you.
The wind bears the scent of far places, %s. It stirs a wolf's blood.
Sun or moon, %s, I stay at your side.
All is quiet for now, %s, yet I keep watch.
I listen to the wind, %s. No foe shall pass unmarked.
The pack guards its own, %s. Be at ease.
I shall whet my claws whilst I wait, %s. Call, and I come.
This ground is peaceful, %s. At your word I shall set forth.
A brief rest, %s, and we walk beneath the moon once more.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.ready: Ready for your orders, my Alpha.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.roster_: Select a companion. Right-click him nearby to open his inventory.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.mode_de: Stays close and keeps moving. Monsters ignore it, and it keeps following even when struck.
Fights at your side: joins your attacks, protects you, and strikes back at whatever hurts it.
Waits right here, ignored by monsters, ready to be recalled at any time.

dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.stay_: The moonlit road grows impatient, brother. Ten minutes I may tarry; speak while the hour allows.
message.howlingwerewolf.companion.invali: Use at most 16 characters without control or formatting codes.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
Place four outer altars three blocks north, south, east and west of the central one at the same height.

Offer a Moonbane Pearl in the center and a Wolfsbane flower on each outer altar, then use the center empty-handed. The pearl stays on the altar. The flowers are spent, or returned if the rite fails.

The brother normally approaches from at least 16 blocks away, or arrives at the altar if the way is blocked. The Alpha Trial still uses a badge in the center and pearls on the outer altars.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.m:
A merchant stays for ten minutes and leaves if his chunk unloads. He draws 8 of 13 trades and does not restock.

Buy a Werewolf Pelt for 4 Silver Ingots or 4 Wolfsbane. Sell one for 2 Silver Ingots or 2 Wolfsbane. Each merchant offers at least one trade in each direction.

Other offers include Silver Ingots, Wolfsbane, Moonbane Pearls, and both potions. A recruited merchant becomes a permanent companion.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
Once you are a werewolf and know Pack Oath, use a Werewolf Badge on a merchant and confirm. This spends one badge, and your new companion starts at tier 0.

Pack Oath sets your slots: one until you pass the Alpha Trial, then one per rank of the oath, up to three.

Every companion holds a slot, including while hunting or fallen. A companion you no longer need can be dismissed from the Pack tab: after a separate confirmation it leaves the pack and frees its slot, and whatever it carries is handed back to you.

Respeccing or being cured keeps each companion's record and items. Anyone over the limit rests, and returns at their old tier when you relearn the oath.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.c:
Follow: stays close and keeps moving. Monsters ignore it and it keeps following even when struck, though stray arrows, explosions and the environment can still reach it.

Guard: fights at your side. It joins your attacks, protects you when you are hit, and strikes back at whatever hurts it. It leaves creepers, your allies and pets, and PvP-protected players alone. Choose Guard when heading somewhere dangerous.

Rest: waits right where it is, ready to be recalled at any time. While resting or sorting, monsters ignore it as they do a follower, and it does not strike back.

Following and guarding companions rejoin you across dimensions. Changing orders clears the old attack target.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.i:
Move within eight blocks of your companion and choose Inventory on the Pack tab, or sneak-right-click the companion to open it directly.

The nine slots hold what you put there, plus the spoils of a hunt. Anything that does not fit stays where the companion returns.

Everything is kept if the companion falls.

Only the owner can open it.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.a:
The Appearance tab changes name and coat with a live preview on the left: drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. Choose Apply skin when you are happy.

The model follows the world setting, and Classic and Modern each remember their own coat. Names run up to 32 characters; save an empty name to use the coat's name.

The lower left of the Pack tab sets how all your companions address you, up to 16 characters, saved with the world. Default restores my Alpha.

Only you can see what your companions say.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.h:
A hunt takes your companion away for 1.5–3 MC days, with spoils settled on return. The bar on the Pack tab shows how far along it is.

Rewards depend on how long the hunt lasts and on your companion's tier. Spoils include common Overworld drops, ores and Wolfsbane.

You can recall early at any time, and the time spent so far is settled. Every hunt is followed by two MC days of rest.

Recall works across dimensions, and hunts run on the world clock.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.u:
Companions start at tier 0. Reaching tiers 1, 2 and 3 takes 2, 4 and 8 Moonbane Pearls, up to your Pack Oath rank.

Tier 0: Health 30, Attack 6
Tier 1: Health 40, Attack 8, Armor 10%
Tier 2: Health 50, Attack 10, Armor 20%
Tier 3: Health 60, Attack 12, Armor 30%

After five seconds out of combat, it heals 1, 1.5, 2 or 2.5 health per second.

Higher tiers earn more loot rolls on a hunt.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
A fallen companion keeps name, coat, tier and inventory. Spend one Werewolf Badge on the Pack tab to bring it back at full health. Stand in the open: the badge is only spent when the revival succeeds.

Hunt rest keeps counting down through falling and revival.

Press C to open this window, or change it in Controls; Esc closes it.

Servers can switch companions with gameplay.enableCompanions. While off, records and items are kept and hunts and rest are paused, then resume when it is on again.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.s:
Have your companion tidy the storage around it:

1. Bring it to the middle of your storage, open the Sorting tab and choose Start sorting.
2. Chests and barrels within sixteen blocks of where it stands join the job, up to the nearest 64. The radar marks them.
3. It walks over, opens the lid, takes the items, carries them to their new container, and closes up.

Two methods:
Consolidate: gathers each item into the container that holds the most of it.
Merge stacks: tops up existing partial stacks.

Item frames: hang a filled item frame on a container and it keeps only that item. Matching items are brought in from elsewhere, and everything else moves out to plain containers. Frames match by item type, whatever the name or enchantments; one container can wear several frames, and an empty frame is only decoration.

Private storage: your companion passes over trapped chests and shulker boxes, so keep anything you want left as it is in those.

Items merge when the item and all its data match, and unstackable gear stays where it is unless a frame calls for it. Items change hands only as they are set down, so you can stop any time and everything stays in its container.

Containers in use, locked or protected and unopened loot chests are skipped for now and shown in gray on the radar. A container your companion cannot walk up to is still tidied from where it stands if it is within 32 blocks; only those farther away are skipped.

After a full round it stays on site and keeps watch; give any other order to end the job. Work pauses while you are offline or in another dimension, and resumes when you return.

Servers can switch this alone with gameplay.enableCompanionSorting.

dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.sorte: It is done, %s. All your stores lie in good order.
Rest easy, %s. I shall set these stores in good order.
The scent of these stores is tangled and neglected, %s. Leave them to my claws to set right.
As you command, %s. I shall open each in turn and see all things to their place.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.sort_: One chest lies beyond my reach, %s. I must leave it be for now.
New goods have come to the stores, %s. I shall see to them.
The stores have grown again, %s. Let me put them right.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.idle_: Fear not, %s. These stores are in my keeping.

screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.s:
Companions are werewolf brothers sworn to you. Five steps bring your first one along:

1. Learn Pack Oath in the progression screen.
2. Build the altars: one central altar, with a regular altar three blocks away on each side, all at the same height.
3. Put a Wolfsbane flower on each outer altar and a Moonbane Pearl in the center, then right-click the central altar with an empty hand.
4. When the merchant arrives, use a Werewolf Badge on him and confirm.
5. Press C to open this window and give your first order.

After that, pick any chapter on the left.
message.howlingwerewolf.pounce_invalid: You cannot pounce to that spot.
message.howlingwerewolf.pounce_aiming: Aim at the ground · %1$s Leap · %2$s Cancel
item.howlingwerewolf.hunter_crossbow.des: Arrows deal 25% extra damage to werewolves and apply Weakness I for 2 seconds. Each target can be weakened once every 5 seconds.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.item.hunter: Village patrol hunters sometimes carry a Silver-Oath Crossbow. Craft it with a crossbow and four Silver Ingots. It accepts standard crossbow enchantments.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.settlements: Hunter outposts and werewolf tribes dot the Overworld. Both offer trade and supplies, and their members fight one another. Watch for patrols when approaching a hunter outpost in werewolf form.

Some villages are guarded by a watchtower, an armory and a training yard. Patrol hunters carry silver swords or Silver-Oath Crossbows, whose arrows can weaken werewolves. The Moonwarden wears a Silverhide Coat and Leggings and supports the patrol with Instant Health II potions.

Tribes can be found in forests, birch forests, taigas, plains and savannas. Local materials shape the chief’s longhouse, workshops and Moon-Oath ritual site. Residents go about their day before returning to their beds at night. Bring the offerings to the existing altars to start a trial or summon a werewolf brother.

The Moonwarden and the chief can restock used offers at their workstations during the day. Check their offers to barter with silver ingots, wolfsbane, werewolf pelts and other goods. Chests and barrels hold food and supplies, and may contain a Moonbane Pearl.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.follo: The wind scatters tracks, %s, but never our pack scent. I follow.
The hunting ground lies ahead. Lead on as you will, %s.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.guard: While I hold this ground, none shall stir the grass unmarked. Rest easy, %s.
My claws are set to the soil. This outpost is secure, %s.
A brief rest upon this soil, %s. My eyes rest, yet my ears track the wind.
The hearth grows warm, %s. Speak the word and I rise at once.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.comba: The scent of blood stirs the air! Watch me break their ranks, %s!
None shall bar the path of %s! To the teeth with them!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.wound: A mere scratch upon the hide! While %s stands with me, I do not yield.
Breath remains in me yet! I have another bite to give, %s!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.victo: Broken bone and quiet earth... The hunt is ended, %s, and the spoils are ours.
The foe is dead. Gather the spoils and let us press forward, %s.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.full_: The moon burns full tonight, %s! Hark the wild cry on the wind—our blood runs hot!
The pale moon rides high. The woods are ours tonight, %s!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.sunri: Dawn breaks upon the dark. Sunlight stings a wolf's eye, yet I walk close by your side, %s.
Heavy rain washes away our scent and spoor, %s... though soaked fur is an ill cloak.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.playe: Stand back, %s! Your blood spills on the ground—let my claws be your shield!
The glory of the Moon-Crown! The timberlands tremble in your stride... Hail, my Alpha!
Unstoppable fury and pristine form... It is an honor to hunt at your side, %s!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.biome: Crisp frost and pine upon the wind... This cold timber feels like true home, %s.
The brimstone here chokes the throat. Tread carefully, %s; let not the hellfire singe your pads.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.companion.water: Deep water slows the hunt, %s. I shall have to shake out my coat once we make dry bank.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.greeti: Well met beneath the moon, brother. What errand moves you to summon me?
The scent of wolfsbane led my paws across the ridges. Speak, kin—what wares do you seek?
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.stay_n: The moonlit road grows impatient, brother. Ten minutes I may tarry; speak while the hour allows.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.time_w: The wind shifts, brother. My packs are nearly lashed; in two short minutes I must depart.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.traded: A fair bargain, fairly struck. Good hunting to you, brother.
Stout trade. Raw silver and prime pelts do not come easy in the deep woods.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.idle.0: Walking the ridges year in and out, one learns to trust only stout wares and sharp teeth.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.idle.1: Ware those who carry silver blades near the valley... The watchtowers have been stirred of late.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.merchant.farewe: Long is the moonlit road, brother. Here I take my leave.
Our business is concluded, brother. Call upon me at the altars when next you have need.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.greet.hu: Keep your torch shielded, traveler. The shadows in the wood have eyes for the village lights.
By silver we are sworn. While our blades hold, no beast shall set paw past these boundaries.
Do you seek silver for defense, or wolfsbane draughts? Best see your kit well-stocked before sundown.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.greet.in: Stand firm... Your breath comes fevered, and wild blood stirs beneath your gaze. Drink a wolfsbane draught ere night falls, lest the beast claim your reason.
I know the scent of a deepwood bite. Should you hear howling on the wind, purge the infection while your mind is yet your own.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.greet.hu: Silver thread tanned into wolfskin... A stout and weather-hardened coat. The wild hunts have served you well.
Silver-tanned hide keeps out the cold and stands up to claws. You've kept that armor in good shape.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.trade.op: Stores and draughts drawn from the watchtower armory. Take what your errand requires.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.trade.do: Fairly bargained. Take them, and may the silver light guide your steps home.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.combat.s: They breach the perimeter! Draw steel—purged in silver!
Back, wretches! While the tower banner flies, this village shall not fall!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.warden.combat.h: Healing potion! Hold the line, sworn guards, and press the attack with me!
The moon burns too fierce tonight... Wind the watchtower arbalests and double the patrol. Let no man sleep.
The wind carries damp leaves... and the rank scent of wet fur.
You can see the tree line from the watchtower. As long as the lantern is lit, the sentries will see anything that slips across the village border.
The armory just tuned a batch of Silver-Oath Crossbows. Keep their latches clean. When a feral werewolf charges, the first shot can make all the difference.
Silverhide bends like leather and takes the bite out of frost and claws. Each piece lets you travel a little quicker, too.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.greet.hum: Fragile two-legged creature... Bring not the scent of harvested grain against our totems. Speak softly if you value your breath.
The tribe welcomes a fair trade. If you’ve brought silver or herbs, take a look at my wares. If you wish to prove your mettle, drink of the moon’s blood.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.greet.wer: I catch the scent of the wild woods... Well met, kin. The moon is high; have your claws tasted warm quarry tonight?
Bone and fangs are the sole truth beneath the stars. Run the timberlands; let not soft hearths dull your edge.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.greet.alp: The hum of the Moon-Crown... The high ridges bow before you. Hail, Alpha; our pack heeds your stride.
Such pure and dreadful fury... Even my aged blood stirs in awe. You bear the true mantle of the wild.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.greet.qua: A proud stride of the first wolves. Run free; tread the howling wind, for these deep woods are yours to hunt.
Only on four paws do you learn how vast the wild is. Go, kin. The quarry and the night wind are waiting.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.trade.ope: Look through the pack's game and herbs. We trade in silver, wolfsbane, and werewolf pelts.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.trade.don: Fairly bartered. May wild blood keep you fierce until the next full moon.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.combat.de: Pack! Bare your fangs! Tear apart any fool who treads unbidden upon our soil!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.combat.he: Healing potion! On your feet, kin! The moonblood still runs hot. Tear through them with me!
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.ambient.f: Hark... the howling on the night wind. The Moon-Mother summons her brood; tonight, the timberlands are ours.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.ambient.i: Smoke from the hearth keeps off the gnats, yet nothing quiets the hunger in the blood.
Our Moon-Oath Altars have stood for generations. Come closer. Do you hear the low hum in the stone? The wild is calling for a true Alpha.
We bring wolfsbane for the trial and Moonbane Pearls to call our kin. However far a lone wolf roams, the Moon-Oath can guide it home.
The hunters put their faith in towers and crossbows. We keep the Moon-Oath our ancestors made here. Iron rusts, but the Moon-Mother’s teeth never dull.
dialogue.howlingwerewolf.chief.combat.de: Behind me, kin. Pack, surround the hunters!
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.settlements: With command permissions, use /locate structure #howlingwerewolf:werewolf_tribes to find the nearest werewolf tribe, or /locate structure howlingwerewolf:hunter_watchtower to find a watchtower.
screen.howlingwerewolf.guide.growth.poun: Pounce costs 3 Skill Points. Press Z to aim, then left-click to leap or right-click to cancel. Maximum range is 25 blocks as a biped, 28 as a quadruped and 23 in Beast Form. The three landing effects share a 20-second cooldown and grant Speed I for 5 seconds.
